title: Rabbinic Authority IV

description: Family, children's welfare, and the case of the modern day agunah, a wife who is unable to get divorced due to her husband’s recalcitrance. Complete Halakhah text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Halakhah is the body of Jewish law and its literature: the codes that arrange it and the works that argue it. Codes compress centuries of debate, so they are presented as their own genre rather than as scripture.
